system_metadata.grounding_source: Business Model Generation: A Handbook for Visionaries, Game Changers, and Challengers (2010)

CS.name: Customer Segments
CS.definition: The different groups of people or organizations an enterprise aims to reach and serve.

VP.name: Value Propositions
VP.definition: The bundle of products and services that create value for a specific Customer Segment.

CH.name: Channels
CH.definition: How a company communicates with and reaches its Customer Segments to deliver a Value Proposition.

CR.name: Customer Relationships
CR.definition: The types of relationships a company establishes with specific Customer Segments.

R$.name: Revenue Streams
R$.definition: The cash a company generates from each Customer Segment.

KR.name: Key Resources
KR.definition: The most important assets required to make a business model work.

KA.name: Key Activities
KA.definition: The most important things a company must do to make its business model work.

KP.name: Key Partnerships
KP.definition: The network of suppliers and partners that make the business model work.

C$.name: Cost Structure
C$.definition: All costs incurred to operate a business model.

unbundling.core_concept: Separating Customer Relationship Management, Product Innovation, and Infrastructure Management into distinct entities to avoid cultural and economic trade-offs.

long_tail.core_concept: Selling less of more by offering a vast number of niche items that sell infrequently, aggregating revenues to rival bestsellers.

multi_sided_platforms.core_concept: Bringing together two or more interdependent customer groups where the platform creates value by facilitating interactions and capturing network effects.

free_as_a_business_model.core_concept: At least one customer segment continuously benefits from a free offer, financed by non-paying users or another side of the platform.

sub_patterns.advertising: Multi-sided platform where ad fees subsidize free content (e.g. Metro, Google).
sub_patterns.freemium: Free basic service with paid premium upgrade; key metric is conversion rate & cost per free user (e.g. Flickr, Skype, Red Hat).
sub_patterns.bait_and_hook: Cheap/free initial 'bait' creates contractual or technological lock-in for high-margin repeat 'hook' purchases (e.g. Gillette Razor & Blades, Free Mobile Phones, HP Inkjet Printers).

open_business_models.core_concept: Systematically collaborating with external partners to create and capture value.

directions.outside_in: Exploiting external ideas/IP inside the firm (e.g. Procter & Gamble Connect & Develop).
directions.inside_out: Monetizing idle internal ideas/IP externally (e.g. GlaxoSmithKline Patent Pools, InnoCentive).

innovation_epicenters: Finance-Driven (Driven by new revenue streams or cost structures)
Multiple-Epicenter Driven (Transforming several blocks simultaneously, e.g. Hilti tool rental)
six_design_techniques: Customer Insights (Empathy Map: See, Hear, Think & Feel, Say & Do, Pain, Gain)
Visual Thinking (Post-it notes, Drawings, Seeing Relationships, Visual Grammar)
Prototyping (Napkin Sketch -> Elaborated Canvas -> Business Case -> Field Test)
Storytelling (Employee Observer vs. Customer Perspective; Introducing the New)
Scenarios (Customer Context Scenarios vs. Future Environmental Scenarios)

strategic_assessment_frameworks.swot_assessment: Evaluating Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, and Threats for every single building block.

blue_ocean_four_actions.eliminate: Which factors that the industry takes for granted should be eliminated?
blue_ocean_four_actions.reduce: Which factors should be reduced well below industry standards?
blue_ocean_four_actions.raise: Which factors should be raised well above industry standards?
blue_ocean_four_actions.create: Which factors should be created that the industry has never offered?

case_benchmarks.swatch: Autonomous brand management with centralized R&D, purchasing, and manufacturing.
case_benchmarks.nespresso: Complete structural separation into a standalone subsidiary (Nespresso SA) to protect direct-to-consumer model from Nescafé retail culture.
case_benchmarks.car2go: Phased pilot approach (Internal -> Extended -> Public City Test) before fixing final organizational structure.

coffee_capsule_example.purpose: Simple offer (home espresso) fans into many canvas sticky notes. Teach the reading, then ask for this venture's equivalent.

Value Proposition: High-end restaurant quality espresso at home

coffee_capsule_example.teaching_move: When a block is empty or abstract, show that block's sample sticky notes, then ask for this venture's equivalent sticky notes.
